strings.catalogue_intro: Choose a library, browse its sections, then open an original document.
strings.choose_library_help: Select a library from the overview. Each library includes its sections and their documents.
strings.config_error: The library settings could not be loaded. Check the local connection and reload.
strings.load_error: The catalogue could not be loaded. Check the local library connection and try again.
strings.documents_error: These documents could not be loaded. Try again.
strings.no_versions_help: A curator needs to create a catalogue version and organise its documents into libraries.
strings.no_libraries_help: Libraries appear here when a curator adds top-level folders to this catalogue version.
strings.no_documents: This library has no documents yet.
strings.search_help: Searches document metadata in this library or section, including its child sections.
strings.original_unavailable: No original file is recorded for this document.
strings.page_help: Page numbers refer to the original PDF. The catalogue does not record its page count.
strings.review_notice: Uploading a document or recording a review date does not establish approval for technical advice. Check its source and scope before relying on it.
strings.missing_document: This document is not in the selected library.
strings.missing_library: This library is not in the selected catalogue version.
strings.synthetic_text: Example documents for interface and workflow checks. They are not community guidance.
strings.about_purpose: Oasis Library is the library catalogue and curator workspace for Kuwala’s offline community information hub.
strings.about_oasis: Oasis is the conversational interface to this library. Oasis stands for Off-grid Autonomous Solar Intelligence System.
strings.about_offline: This interface uses local assets and original files. Visitor search covers catalogue metadata; private curator passage search reuses Oasis’s local text and semantic indexes.
strings.acknowledgement: Oasis Library is a Kuwala fork of SolarSPELL’s Digital Library Management System, developed at Arizona State University. We acknowledge SolarSPELL’s work in making offline educational resources available to communities.
strings.licence_distinction: The upstream MIT licence is preserved. Each library document retains its own attribution, rights and licence; the software licence does not grant rights to those documents.
